I answered Hollis in the thread on his message: the Marrow Agrisupply store is **Pine Crossing**.

It comes from #central-team, a channel Hollis is in. On June 9, 2026, Priyanka Sundaram posted that the Pine Crossing morning receiver's appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver had arrived at 7:10 the day before, and the staff wrote his trailer number on a sticky note.
